from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    def separator_indices(lines):
        uniform = {}
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if all(x == line[0] for x in line):
                uniform.setdefault(line[0], []).append(i)
        if not uniform:
            return []
        # Solid divider lines are the rare, repeated full lines; ignore the
        # dominant solid background when a grid has large empty areas.
        color = min(uniform, key=lambda c: len(uniform[c]))
        return uniform[color]

    row_seps = separator_indices(grid)
    col_seps = separator_indices([[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)] for c in range(w)])
    row_starts = [0] + [i + 1 for i in row_seps]
    row_ends = row_seps + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [i + 1 for i in col_seps]
    col_ends = col_seps + [w]
    heights = [b-a for a,b in zip(row_starts,row_ends)]
    widths = [b-a for a,b in zip(col_starts,col_ends)]
    th, tw = heights[-1], widths[-1]
    src_r, src_c = row_starts[-1], col_starts[-1]
    for ri, (rs,re) in enumerate(zip(row_starts,row_ends)):
        for ci, (cs,ce) in enumerate(zip(col_starts,col_ends)):
            if re-rs != th or ce-cs != tw:
                continue
            for dr in range(th):
                for dc in range(tw):
                    out[rs+dr][cs+dc] = grid[src_r+dr][src_c+dc]
    return out
'''
